name: Body assembly (organs, tissues, vessel graph)
formulation: Zero-mass organ shells wired by blood_in/out edges to a 'vessels' node; species differences come from library columns
invariants: blood volume must equal mass*mL/kg if circulation already initialised
sources: ANA-ORG (Guyton and Hall; Boron and Boulpaep), no page numbers
approximations: organ masses null (unsourced); horse Hb/ventilation null
tests: anatomy.test.ts: builds every human organ...; builds horse column; fails missing organ rows before mutating
notes: Organ masses all null so shells carry none

name: Species profile from library columns
formulation: RMR horse = 70*kg^0.75 (Kleiber) parsed from text; human RMR deferred to Mifflin-St Jeor in physiology
approximations: only human and one horse column; formula text regex-parsed
tests: anatomy.test.ts horse column; independence.test.ts matches Kleiber RMR, CO, blood volume
notes: Resting cardiac output 0.07 L/min/kg here AND circulation has its own cardiac-output normal: two homes for resting CO. Blood volume 70 mL/kg here AND circulation normalBloodVolume (anatomy asserts equality at L112)

name: Organ function = min(input adequacies) x (1 - damage)

inputs.name: input adequacies (perfusion, tissue integrity, host signals)

formulation: function = min(inputs) * (1 - damage); inputs sampled before publishing to avoid cycle-order effects
approximations: no organ-specific oxygen/fuel/temperature/toxin adequacy conversions; cascades qualitative only
tests: anatomy.test.ts: reads inputs from graph edges...; applies health times input adequacy...
consumers: crisis tracking, circulation perfusion output, host
notes: Only perfusion + host signals feed it; hydration, anaemia, oxygen adequacies are not wired, so organ function is blind to dehydration (library says 6-10% deficit => kidney injury)

name: Organ damage accumulation and repair
formulation: damage += days*insult*(1-resistance) - (insult==0 && repairAllowed ? days*rate); rates liver .01 skin/gut .05 heart/brain(nerves) 0 kidney .001 parsed from repair text
approximations: insult/resistance are host inputs; no derived toxin/ischaemia insults; repair needs explicit nutrition gate by host (not wired)
tests: anatomy.test.ts: applies health times input adequacy, daily repair...
notes: Bone repair 0.005 in library text has no organ in code; ischaemia insult (function<0.3 for >1h) unmodelled

name: Collagen integrity falls with vitamin C pool
formulation: if vit_c pool < 300 mg then integrity -= 0.02/day
approximations: only collagen has a numeric rule; bone, epithelium, muscle, nerve none
tests: anatomy.test.ts: updates collagen daily from the nutrition pool
notes: Third consumer of the same vit_c<300 mg threshold: nutrition deficiency stage 1, medicine healing x3, and this. Medicine flags say anatomy collagen 'carries' scurvy while medicine.healing also multiplies healing time x3

name: Organ crisis floors
formulation: brain/heart/lungs <=0.2, liver/kidneys <=0.1 opens crisis; engine never kills
sources: pirate-ship ANATOMY.md 3a (2026-10-29), not a library row
approximations: design thresholds; no death roll
tests: anatomy.test.ts: class IV emits crisis; applies...without a death outcome
notes: Constants live in code and cite a pirate-ship doc

name: Gut function gates absorption
formulation: eatMeal(..., gutFunction = intestines.function) so absorption x function
approximations: horse feeding disabled (no absorption numbers)
tests: anatomy.test.ts: reuses nutrition absorption

name: Respiratory profile (max ventilation etc.)
formulation: read via atmosphere.respiratoryProfile
approximations: human only; diffusing capacity rows qualitative
tests: anatomy.test.ts horse refuses missing ventilation
notes: Gas exchange owned by atmosphere (outside this batch)

name: Blood volume and haemoglobin ledger
formulation: volume = initial + in - out; shed blood leaves with current Hb conc; body mass -= mL*1.06 kg/L /1000
invariants: trace.check volume:blood and mass:haemoglobin each step (1e-6/1e-9)
approximations: no plasma/cell split except Hb; no refill; blood density from library
tests: circulation.test.ts: clotting scales wounds; recovers by host's tau with Hb dilution; checkpoint2: body mass conserved incl shed blood
consumers: bleed, medicine wounds, nutrition (iron loss intended)
notes: Blood lost is tracked in mL (props.blood_lost_ml) but nutrition iron loss reads props.blood_lost_l (litres, different name); nothing writes blood_lost_l, so iron loss from haemorrhage is unwired (unit AND name mismatch)

name: Normal blood volume by mass and sex
formulation: mass * 70 mL/kg (men) / 65 (women), parsed from table source text
approximations: parsed from prose
tests: circulation.test.ts reads normals
notes: Duplicates anatomy.species blood-volume-ml-kg (70 human, 80 horse)

name: Haemorrhage class by cumulative loss fraction
formulation: pct = loss/baseline*100; thresholds 15/30/40 from table; effects regex-read from text
approximations: deathRatePerHour is a PLACEHOLDER (0/1/10/50% per h) flagged unmeasured; MAP null after fluid replacement
tests: circulation.test.ts: 1500 mL in 70 kg man is III; checkpoint2: prescribed-loss probe
notes: Library organ-consequence text also says 'Endurance pool x0.8 (BODY)', 'Wits x0.7' (game attributes) which overlap hydration table Endurance/Wits factors; stacking risk if the host multiplies both

name: Wound bleed volume = rate x time x (N - clotting)
formulation: loss = rate*seconds/60*(2 - clotting); 0 if bound; N=2 parsed from table source sentence
approximations: rate and clotting have NO source; host supplies both (D-ROW question to Rex on thrust bleed rate)
tests: circulation.test.ts clotting scales wounds; bleedFactor test; checkpoint2
notes: (N - clotting) with N=2 is a model form, not physics

name: Oxygen delivery DO2 = CO x 1.34 x Hb x SaO2 x (1-COHb) x 10
formulation: DO2 = CO*1.34*Hb*SaO2*(1-COHb)*10
approximations: bound O2 only; dissolved O2 omitted
tests: circulation.test.ts: uses atmospheric saturation and CO binding in delivery
notes: CO is null unless host gives flow/resistance (no volume->CO curve), so DO2 is usually null

name: Cardiac output = MAP/resistance (host supplied)
home: Toolchain/realism/src/circulation.ts circulationProcess L163; anatomy.ts assemblyCirculation L229-237
formulation: CO = options.cardiacOutputLMin ?? MAP/resistance; anatomy passes mass*0.07 L/min/kg only when resting (no blood loss, heart function 1)
approximations: no CO-vs-volume curve
tests: circulation.test.ts: disables missing kinetics

name: Aerobic ceiling = DO2 at maximal CO
formulation: DO2 evaluated at maximal cardiac output (20 L/min sourced 2560)
approximations: maximal CO fixed, not fitness-scaled
tests: circulation.test.ts maximal output 20
notes: One of three aerobic-capacity notions: this, Banister performance (muscular), and the 'Endurance pool' (physiology recovery table, unimplemented)

name: First-order blood-volume recovery from replacement fluid
formulation: ml = min(supply, deficit*(1-exp(-dt/tau)))
approximations: disabled without host tau; no oral absorption
tests: circulation.test.ts: recovers by host's experimental tau
notes: No link from physiology water deficit/ingest to blood volume: circulation delivery_failures says dehydration lowers plasma but nothing reduces blood_volume_ml

name: Cardiovascular event hazards (unmeasured)
formulation: angina index*k; MI index^2*k (x trigger); arrhythmia % table; stroke index^2*k; thrombosis % if immobile
approximations: explicitly placeholders; never rolled; units mixed per event (per-day/hour/event/state)
tests: circulation.test.ts: conditional unmeasured hazards (2 tests)
notes: Mixed rate units per row; dehydrated/fever/sepsis are boolean flags with no producer; atherosclerosis index has no updater

name: Homeostatic regulation loops (metadata only)
formulation: metadata only; tauSeconds null for all 7 loops (baroreflex, kidney volume, erythropoiesis, glucose, K+, O2, acid-base)
approximations: none implemented
tests: circulation.test.ts every loop has failsWhen and null tau
notes: MISSING: all 7 loops; acid_base and H2S outputs set null

name: Metabolic power from MET scaled to body RMR
formulation: M = metabolicHeat(MET, mass)*scale, scale = RMR*J/86400/metabolicHeat(1,mass); heat = M - min(work_w, M)
invariants: energy:chemical traced; test conserves intake - heat - work = stored
approximations: MET table values are nearest-activity
tests: physiology.test.ts: energy (6 tests) incl conserves energy
notes: VO2=3.5*MET*mass is in physics.metabolicHeat (physics.ts:81-83) and in atmosphere vo2PerMet (atmosphere.ts:194): atmosphere uses UNSCALED VO2 while physiology scales energy to the body RMR, so gas exchange and energy expenditure disagree when RMR != 1 kcal/kg/h. Metabolic water uses the scaled M

name: Resting metabolic rate (Mifflin-St Jeor)
formulation: Mifflin-St Jeor; fallback 1 kcal/kg/h if height/age/sex missing; props.rmr_kcal_day overrides (horse Kleiber)
approximations: fallback differs
tests: physiology.test.ts 70 kg man resting rate; falls back to 1 kcal/kg/h
notes: Two RMR definitions by species, injected by the host via props.rmr_kcal_day

name: Physical activity level of closed day
formulation: PAL = day expenditure / RMR
tests: physiology.test.ts: makes day's PAL MET-hours over 24

name: Sleep debt overnight tick and alertness multiplier
formulation: debt += max(0,8 - slept) - max(0, slept - 8), floor 0; multiplier by band 1.0/.92/.82/.70/.55; split sleep counts 0.85
approximations: no 60 h cap; quality weights other than split not in library
tests: physiology.test.ts: 14 nights at 4 h reach table's alertness; weighs split sleep
consumers: alertness; medicine healing (>24 h x1.2); neurology baseline (unsized, off)
notes: SLEEP DEBT is consumed by physiology alertness, medicine healing (x1.2) and (as hours) muscular sleepGate; neurology adds a parallel hours_awake -> adenosine -> arousal chain described as the 'mechanism under' the same table

name: Circadian factor by clock hour
formulation: lookup of band factor
approximations: column 'Ship's time' and maritime watch studies
tests: physiology.test.ts scales alertness by time of day
notes: Sourced from maritime watch studies but applied to any human

name: Alertness = sleep-debt multiplier x circadian
formulation: alertness = debtMultiplier * circadian
approximations: product, no interaction
tests: physiology.test.ts
notes: Separate from neurology arousal circuit (tone-based, driven by hours awake): two alertness-like outputs with no declared relation

name: Whole-body fatigue as accumulated MET-hours
formulation: += MET*dt; resets to 0 after >=7 h sleep, else carries (8-slept)/8
approximations: output only; nothing consumes it for capacity
tests: physiology.test.ts sleep tests
notes: FATIGUE is computed in three places: this (whole-body MET-h), muscular 3CC per group, and muscular Banister fatigue (tau 7 d). No declared relation

name: Core temperature drift above WBGT ceiling
formulation: ceiling = unacc + acclim*(acc - unacc) by MET class; core += max(0,WBGT-ceiling)*drift(C/h/C)*dt
approximations: no cooling term, no cold side; falls only via overnight reset to 37.0 when sheltered
tests: physiology.test.ts: MET 6 worker in 32 C drifts; holds core below ceiling; returns to rest overnight
consumers: core band, neurology heat strain, hydration
notes: core_c (library drift state) and body.temperatureC (lumped tissue heat balance) are two separate temperature states for one body

name: Core temperature band to work capacity
formulation: band lookup; 'work capacity xN' parsed from text
tests: physiology.test.ts reports band above ceiling
notes: WORK CAPACITY has three separate outputs (work_capacity_heat, work_capacity_hydration, endurance_hydration); hydration row 2-4% also says 'heat strain faster', overlapping WBGT drift if the host also reads core

name: Heat acclimatisation gain/loss
formulation: +1/14 per heat-work day, -1/25 otherwise
approximations: 'day of work in heat' definition is a model choice
tests: physiology.test.ts: gains acclimatisation over the table's days

name: Skin and breath heat exchange (ISO 7730 PMV)
formulation: skin = 35.7-0.028(M-W); resp latent 1.7e-5 M(5867-pa); diffusion 3.05e-3(5733-6.99(M-W)-pa); radiation 3.96e-8(Tcl^4-Tr^4); hc=max(2.38|dT|^.25,12.1 sqrt v); Lewis 16.5 K/kPa
invariants: heat conserved (test: stored = in - air - sweat latent - breath latent)
approximations: comfort skin T, no clothing, Tr=air; dripped sweat does not cool
tests: physiology.test.ts conserves heat in the body; hydration-week.test.ts

name: Body surface area (DuBois)
tests: hydration-week.test.ts: takes skin area from DuBois

name: Sweat rate from required evaporation, capped
formulation: sweat = clamp(Ereq - skin diffusion, 0, 2.5 L/h*latent); max when core band says 'sweat rate at max'; evaporation capped by Lewis, rest drips
sources: ISO 7933 concept (not its equations); hydration source 2.5 L/h
approximations: ISO 7933 equations not used; Gonzalez 2018 candidate noted
tests: hydration-week.test.ts: hard worker sweat inside band; physiology.test.ts cannot sweat more than body holds
notes: nutrition treats sweat kg as litres (1 kg/L) in sodium use

name: Water balance: in (drink, food, metabolic), out (sweat, diffusion, breath, urine)
formulation: deficit += losses - intake - metabolic; urine between obligatory and max-dilute; outflows capped to water held
invariants: mass:water traced and checked each step
approximations: no faecal water; no seawater; no ADH lag
tests: physiology.test.ts: conserves water each step; hydration-week.test.ts (4 tests)
notes: Water exists as body.contents 'water' (registry mass, only if component holds some), props.waterDeficitKg, glycogen-bound water (nutrition) and (unlinked) blood volume

name: Urine output between osmolar limits
approximations: 600 mOsm/day fixed, not mass or diet scaled (horse passes human's)
tests: hydration-week.test.ts
notes: Constants hard-coded in physiology.ts (URINE), not library rows

name: Metabolic water = RQ x O2
formulation: water = RQ * molesO2(M/20.1 kJ/L) * M(H2O) * dt
approximations: protein and triglyceride fuel mix ignored; ~0.5 kg/day vs Guyton 0.2 L/d
tests: physiology.test.ts water conservation

name: Hydration deficit band to effect factors
formulation: bands 0-1/1-2/2-4/4-6/6-10/>10; 'Endurance xN (xM in heat)' parsed; >=6% incapacitated crisis, >=10% death-risk crisis
approximations: skin-T shift not implemented; row also names Wits x0.9, Strength x0.9, kidney injury (not parsed)

approximations: physiology flags say not implemented here; implemented in muscular.ts
tests: muscular.test.ts uses the 42/7 day response

tests: none

name: Cold-water immersion times
formulation: table lookup only; no cold side in core_c
approximations: no code

name: Three-compartment muscle fatigue
formulation: recruit=effort*rest*dt; fatigue=F*active*dt; recover=R*fatigued*dt; at rest active->resting at once and fatigued decays exp(-R t)
invariants: sum to 1 (1e-12) checked every step; trace transfers
sources: Xia and Frey Law 2008; Frey Law, Looft, Heitsman 2012 Table 1
approximations: cannot produce 120 s exhaustion at 50% (flagged); 9 groups have no joint mapping (null)
tests: muscular.test.ts: seconds-based 3CC (3 tests)

name: Activation profile per action at its MET

approximations: k_o,k_n,k_t absent; gates are host inputs; no tissue mass or protein/energy consumption
tests: muscular.test.ts: raises contractile over 14 stimuli; preserves first detrained week; carries gated signal
notes: The gates re-read states owned by nutrition (protein, energy balance) and physiology (sleep), the same states medicine.healing multiplies; both are caller-supplied so no internal double-apply, but not centrally owned

name: Aggregate epidemic through disease course
formulation: share = min(catch*(1-seasoned), 1 - seasoned - caught); deaths per batch per day = n*risk/courseDays; survivors of lifelong-immunity disease join seasoned share

tests: population.test.ts: epidemic through disease course (3 tests)
notes: Aggregate duplicate of medicine.expose/advanceDays; expected value vs Bernoulli draw; agreement in the mean not tested

name: Famine rule on stores
formulation: foodDays -= 1; if <0: health -= 0.02/day, births x0.5, deaths x1.5
approximations: no health recovery; foodDays host-supplied

name: Migration in/out and settlers
formulation: settlers = prosperity*reputation*0.001 per day; leavers host
approximations: transient pool has no births/deaths/ageing

name: Labour supply

notes: Health already scales births and deaths; labour multiplies by health again and by the sick share; labour supply is also an economy/settlement concept
